questiontext.text:
A circular fountain sits at the centre of a garden. A sprinkler head, mounted on a post at the fountain's centre \(O\), rotates and sprays water outward, watering the lawn beyond the fountain's edge over an angle of \({@theta@}^\circ\).

The fountain has a radius of \({@r@}\,\text{cm}\), and the sprinkler's water reaches a maximum distance of \({@R@}\,\text{cm}\) from \(O\).

Calculate the area of lawn watered by the sprinkler (the shaded region shown), correct to \(3\,\text{decimal places}\). (Use \(\pi=\frac{22}{7}\))

[[jsxgraph]] var brd = JXG.JSXGraph.initBoard('jxgbox', { boundingbox: [-12, 12, 12, -12], axis: false, showNavigation: false, showCopyright: false, keepAspectRatio: true }); // Centre O: the sprinkler post, at the centre of the fountain var O = brd.create('point', [-2, -2], { name: 'O', visible: true, size: 2, fixed: true, label: { offset: [-14, -12], fontSize: 16 } }); // Fixed DISPLAY radii, independent of true R and r values (which vary in cm) var R_outer = 10; var R_inner = 4; // Real swept angle drives the diagram shape var angleDeg = {#theta#}; var angle = angleDeg * Math.PI / 180; // Outer sector boundary (maximum reach of the water) var P = brd.create('point', [O.X() + R_outer, O.Y()], {visible: false}); var Q = brd.create('point', [O.X() + R_outer * Math.cos(angle), O.Y() + R_outer * Math.sin(angle)], {visible: false}); brd.create('sector', [O, P, Q], { fillColor: '#8fd19e', fillOpacity: 0.5, strokeWidth: 2, strokeColor: 'darkgreen' }); // Inner sector, filled to represent the fountain (unwatered, cuts out the centre) var Pin = brd.create('point', [O.X() + R_inner, O.Y()], {visible: false}); var Qin = brd.create('point', [O.X() + R_inner * Math.cos(angle), O.Y() + R_inner * Math.sin(angle)], {visible: false}); brd.create('sector', [O, Pin, Qin], { fillColor: '#4a90d9', fillOpacity: 0.8, strokeWidth: 0 }); // Full fountain circle outline (dashed), to show it's a full circular fountain, // even though only part of its boundary lies within the swept angle brd.create('circle', [O, R_inner], { strokeColor: '#4a90d9', strokeWidth: 1, dash: 2, fillOpacity: 0 }); // Base line marking the start of the sweep var baseEnd = brd.create('point', [O.X() + R_outer, O.Y()], {visible: false}); brd.create('segment', [O, baseEnd], {strokeColor: 'darkgreen', strokeWidth: 2}); brd.create('segment', [O, Q], {strokeColor: 'darkgreen', strokeWidth: 2}); // Angle marker showing theta brd.create('angle', [baseEnd, O, Q], { radius: 2, name: function() { return angleDeg + '°'; } }); // Fountain radius label brd.create('text', [ function() { return O.X() + (R_inner / 2) * Math.cos(angle / 2); }, function() { return O.Y() + (R_inner / 2) * Math.sin(angle / 2) + 0.6; }, function() { return {#r#} + ' cm'; } ]); // Outer reach label brd.create('text', [ function() { return O.X() + ((R_inner + R_outer) / 2) * Math.cos(angle / 2); }, function() { return O.Y() + ((R_inner + R_outer) / 2) * Math.sin(angle / 2) + 0.6; }, function() { return {#R#} + ' cm'; } ]); // "Fountain" label near the inner circle brd.create('text', [O.X() - R_inner - 1.5, O.Y() + 1, 'Fountain']); [[/jsxgraph]]

\(\text{Area of lawn watered}=\)[[input:ans1]]\(\,\text{cm}^2\)[[validation:ans1]][[feedback:prt1]]

generalfeedback.text:
Worked Solution

The watered lawn forms an annular sector — a sector-shaped region with the fountain's circle removed from the centre. From the problem:

  • Sweep angle: \({@theta@}^\circ\)
  • Fountain radius (inner): \(r={@r@}\,\text{cm}\)
  • Sprinkler's maximum reach (outer): \(R={@R@}\,\text{cm}\)

Step 1: Write the formula for the area of an annular sector.

\[ A = \frac{\theta}{360} \times \pi (R^2 - r^2) \]

Step 2: Substitute the values and compute the area.

\[ \begin{align} A &= \frac{{@theta@}}{360} \times \frac{22}{7} \times \left({@R@}^2 - {@r@}^2\right) \\ &= \frac{{@theta@}}{360} \times \frac{22}{7} \times \left({@R_sq@} - {@r_sq@}\right) \\ &= \frac{{@theta@}}{360} \times \frac{22}{7} \times {@Radius_difference@} \\ &= {@A_val@}\,\text{cm}^2 \end{align} \]

Rounded to \(3\) decimal places:

\(\text{Area of lawn watered} \approx {@A_3dp@}\,\text{cm}^2\)
